what: A projection the lazy program could not normalize while laying a coroutine state was reported as the builder's bare `the associated type 0x.. of trait 0x.. was not normalized` (lay_states.rs mapped BuildError::Projection to RunError::Build, dropping the seam's `last_projection`), and the lazy program's own why said only `Check`: two asks to learn it was `Check(Malformed(BodyTypeInRecord(Coroutine(..))))` at Self = a ground coroutine.
cause: the why was printed in two places (eager and lazy normalize), the lazy one without Self's form and with the error cut to its first word; lay_states did not route errors through the projection mapping make_one.rs uses
whys: copied printer drifted; each RunError::Build site maps errors on its own
class: a refusal that drops its cause on one path (rule 19)
prevention: done: one printer, program.rs `projection_why` (trait, Self's form, the whole error up to 300 bytes), used by both programs; lay_states.rs `build_error` names a projection's why at every site
